# Master List Modular Execution Trace Audit — Combined Report

**Audit status:** COMPLETE WITH DOCUMENTED NOT VERIFIED ITEMS
**Production-readiness status:** FAIL — registered callback declarations are missing from the supplied modular source
**Source version:** `1.8.9.8.4.0`
**Governing source:** the ten `.gs` files in `Master_List/Current Production Script/Modules`
**Governing prompt:** `Master_List/Prompts/Menu_Trigger_and_Function_Execution_Trace_Review_Prompt (1).docx.md`

## Interpretation of completion

The audit itself is complete as a static-source review: all 42 menu registrations and both source-defined runtime entries were reviewed; every available named path was traced to termination; absent roots were recorded as FAIL defects; and deployment- or workbook-dependent evidence was retained as NOT VERIFIED. Audit completion does **not** mean that the supplied modular production source is complete or production-ready. In particular, 28 unique registered callbacks are absent, affecting 31 menu registration paths.

This file combines the complete, unabridged contents of Scripts 01–10 in execution order. Script boundaries are retained so stable identifiers, assignments, evidence, reconciliation counts, and certification remain auditable.

## Combined report contents

1. Script 01 — Source, Registration, and Entry-Point Discovery
2. Script 02 — Menu Function Call Graphs, Part 1
3. Script 03 — Menu Function Call Graphs, Part 2
4. Script 04 — Trigger Function Call Graphs
5. Script 05 — Reachable Function Dependency Catalog

8. Script 08 — Read, Write, Side-Effect, Branch, Failure, and Recovery Review
9. Script 09 — Post-Upgrade Integrity and Delta Verification
10. Script 10 — Final Consolidated Execution Trace Audit

### Destructive-operation register

All `deleteSheet`, clearing, archive, and external-workbook source occurrences are classified in the effect matrix. Destructive outcomes are data-dependent; partial completion is possible where writes precede later exceptions. Transactional rollback is not provided by Apps Script and is therefore a WARNING.

### Partial-completion register

| Condition | Classification | Recovery |
|---|---|---|
| Service exception after an earlier write | WARNING | Local `catch` where present; otherwise caller/runtime receives exception; no general rollback |
| Best-effort logging/notification exception | WARNING | Caught paths continue where source provides catches |
| User cancellation or failed validation | PASS/WARNING | Early return prevents later work; exact workbook state depends on prior operations |
